description: KAIRO output/display windows (kairo-*) — display.html only ever calls get_server_token (to authenticate its own WS connection to the local server); scoped narrowly instead of inheriting the main window's full permission set (NDI/Syphon control, app updates, window creation), none of which the output window uses; and output_capture, so an NDI/Syphon output's hidden capture window (display.html?capture=1) can report a change to be captured; and output_video, so that window can hand a full-frame video background to the app to play at full rate under its snapshots.
